metadata.description: Two Agent Skills that carry a project from the chat to the IDE and back: handoff-pack turns ideas or existing projects into validated, agent-ready Markdown handoff packs; handoff-implement executes them in Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and other IDE agents.

plugins.name: handoff-pack
plugins.description: handoff-pack interviews you until every important detail is settled, asks for explicit approval, then writes a Markdown handoff pack (context, architecture, requirements, action plan, pending items). handoff-implement reads that pack in the IDE, checks its integrity, confirms its understanding with you, implements one task at a time within the agreed limits and writes phase reports to update the pack.
